rule.name: SpringAnnotationBeforeProxy
rule.message: Move this work to an @EventListener(ApplicationReadyEvent.class) method or an ApplicationRunner, where the annotation applies: @PostConstruct, afterPropertiesSet and a @Bean initMethod run on the raw bean before Spring wraps it in its proxy, so @Transactional, @Async, @Cacheable, @CachePut, @CacheEvict, @Retryable and @PreAuthorize do nothing on them.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $beans := //MethodDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean')] /AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'initMethod']] return //MethodDeclaration [ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.annotation.PostConstruct') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.annotation.PostConstruct')] or (@Name = 'afterPropertiesSet' and @Arity = 0 and ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean')]) or (@Arity = 0 and (let $name := string(@Name), $owner := string(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/@SimpleName) return some $bean in $beans satisfies ($bean/ClassType/@SimpleName = $owner and $bean/ModifierList/Annotation/AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'initMethod'] //StringLiteral/@ConstValue = $name)))] /ModifierList/Annotation[some $t in ('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional', 'jakarta.transaction.Transactional', 'javax.transaction.Transactional', 'org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async', 'org.springframework.cache.annotation.Cacheable', 'org.springframework.cache.annotation.CachePut', 'org.springframework.cache.annotation.CacheEvict', 'org.springframework.retry.annotation.Retryable', 'org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize') satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($t)]
